general.name: General account
general.description: An ordinary brokerage account. Realized gains are taxed at {gainsRate} and dividends at {dividendsRate}. Losses offset gains and dividends in the same year; what is left carries forward for {carryforwardYears} years if you file a tax return.

saver.name: Saver account
saver.description: A tax-free account for unleveraged equity funds, bought in one go or by a regular plan. You may buy up to {annual} a year; selling does not give that room back.

losses.filing: Offsetting losses within the year needs no tax return. A loss left over carries forward for {carryforwardYears} years only if you file a tax return.

credit.filing: Foreign tax withheld on dividends is credited only if you file a tax return.
